name: Olive Garden Grilled Chicken Breast (Plain Add-On Filet)
whyItWorks: Pure boneless, skinless chicken breast filet seared on the grill. Free of rough breading, cheese, or spices; the ideal protein companion for plain pasta.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Plain grilled chicken breast—unmarinated, NO garlic herb seasoning, NO butter.' Slice over plain olive oil pasta.
